style: Layered paper-collage plate for an art-film: 19th-century steel engraving and mezzotint fused with torn parchment layers and stone mosaics. Strictly muted sepia, bone white, charcoal and dusty ochre — no saturated colour. Dramatic single-source chiaroscuro, deep black gaps and soft drop shadows between the paper layers so the composition reads as a physical 3D stack of plates. Visible engraving cross-hatching, foxed paper grain, dust motes and a faint light shaft. Cinematic 16:9 composition with empty dark space for typography. NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO WORDS, NO WATERMARK, NO FRAME, NO BORDER.

items.name: cave

items.name: doubt

items.name: industry

items.name: abyss

items.name: forest

items.name: ladder

items.name: dawn
